scope: Offline browser interaction reference only; not Obsidian, Three.js, or filesystem analysis

tests.name: B01 Offline initial inventory has 144 files and no selected file
B02 Selection preserves camera and keyboard focus
B03 Closing and reopening inspector preserves selection
B04 Search keeps selected nonmatch and exact camera state
B05 Search Escape clears only the query
B06 Sibling note owns its typing, slash, and Escape
B07 Top-to-3D round trip restores prior camera
B08 Canvas Enter focuses and F fits without clearing selection
B09 Drag changes camera but never selects on release
B10 Pointer picking selects the visible file identity
B11 Simulated rendering failure preserves complete HTML inventory
B12 Narrow drawer Escape closes only inspector and restores focus
B13 Modal traps focus and Escape returns without losing context
B14 Scan consent is reset for every new scope review
B15 Cancellation rejects late completion and retains the snapshot
B16 Failed refresh never replaces the last valid snapshot
B17 Valid simulated refresh publishes exactly one new revision
B18 Zero results never clear selection or move the camera
B19 Non-ASCII path lookup and selection work
B20 Simulator does not continuously render while idle
B21 Theme preview preserves every interaction state field
B22 Every button has visible text or an accessible label
B23 Clipboard failure exposes selectable relative path
B24 Narrow review preserves selection without document overflow
B25 Search does not re-layout file coordinates
B26 IME composition does not dispatch Escape
B27 No external network requests are made
B28 No browser script errors occurred
